title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
relationship: Primary reference for anisotropic Gaussian radiance primitives and visibility-aware splatting; CRF 0.4 does not reproduce its multi-view training.

title: 2D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Radiance Fields
relationship: Oriented surface Gaussian disks in 3D and multiview geometric constraints; distinct from Gaussian image coding.

title: GaussianImage: 1000 FPS Image Representation and Compression by 2D Gaussian Splatting
relationship: 2D Gaussian image representation and accumulation; our dense observation mode does not claim their compression or performance results.

title: Gaussian Grouping: Segment and Edit Anything in 3D Scenes
relationship: Semantic grouping of Gaussians and object editing; our labels are assisted annotations, not trained identity encodings.
